keyFacts: Exercise sheet 1: Shellprogrammierung contains four tasks worth 6, 6, 16 and 16 points (44 total). No submission deadline is stated.
Read the supplied vi reference material.
workloadRules: Complete vimtutor and work on sheets 1 and 2 with the vi editor.
Use only the standard sh commands presented in class.
Task 1: for a call with more than two parameters, print only the last two.
Task 2: validate an even number of parameters; print a Unix-style error to stderr and exit with failure otherwise.
Task 3: list files in the current directory with names at least 3 and less than 6 characters long.
Task 4: print all positional parameters with numbering in reverse order.
